notes.title: 1.4 Update
notes.content:
It only took us around six years… but it's finally here! 🎉

The latest update brings a highly requested feature along with a few additional improvements based on feedback from our most passionate players.

Hotspots are now in the game! Just press the spacebar to highlight them.

No more partial voiceovers—they’ve been completely removed.

Inventory stays open by default when selecting an item, making item combinations quicker.

Various minor tweaks and fixes.

Please note that this update may affect your saved files. While most saves remain playable, we’ve noticed cases where the music doesn’t play. If you run into issues, you can still access the original version 1.3 from the Beta menu.

Thanks for playing, and keep the feedback coming! 🚀 It just might take another few years for an update. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
[h2]Version 1.3 available[/h2]

[h3]What's new[/h3]

- The new version fixes the scrolling bug that some players encountered. Keep in mind that in case you have encountered the bug and you continue a saved game you may still experience it in the new version as well.
- Some much-needed text corrections.
- Some of the game backgrounds have been retouched.
- A couple of other minor fixes.

[h3][h2]But...[/h2][/h3]

The latest version didn't brake the save compatibility with the older version in our tests on windows but unfortunately, it did on mac. The older version is still available in the "Betas" tab within the game properties if "Version 1.2" is selected.

When we say that save compatibility is broken, we do not mean that the game will not load but that several elements will simply not be "Right". The music may be absent, the lighting may be wrong. etc.

tags.bug: - The new version fixes the scrolling bug that some players encountered.
- A couple of other minor fixes.

notes.title: Yet Another Hero Story 1.2 Update for windows
notes.content:
Hello all,

There's been an update to the game that brings a few changes and improvements. Good news, right? 

Unfortunately, there was no way that the changes could be introduced without losing the compatibility of the existing save games.  

[h3][b]Don't worry though, there's a solution, and is provided below.[/b][/h3]

-Right Click on the game in your library
-Click on "Properties"
-Click on the "Betas" Tab
-Select the "Older Version" from the dropdown.
-Click "Close"

That's it. This will sync to the older version and your old save files will be fine. So players who do not want to start the game from the beginning can continue without losing any progress but without the improvements.

[h3][b]What are the changes?[/b][/h3]

-Bug fixes
-Double-clicking on most scene exits, will change to a new scene immediately.
-There's been a correction with an achievement be given too early.
-6 new music themes came to be added and replace some of the older ones. (And they are much better!)

[h3][b]How do I know which version am I running?[/b][/h3]

Simply check if you can see the "Ver. 1.2" text on the main menu screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35259874/6239164022d2527314a0ab68574d4a2422409c91.jpg[/img]

PS. The whole thing doesn't concern mac users, right now.

notes.title: Another Small Update
notes.content:
The game was updated today again. We made a couple of minor fixes and we also fixed an issue that did not allow player to get one of the achievements.

Finally after a couple of comments, we have increased the highlight areas for some of the items that needed to be obtained by the player.
